usage: The word '水' (seoi2) is used as a noun to refer to water in general.
'水' can be used to describe drinking water or water used for other purposes like washing.
You can use '水' in combination with measure words when specifying quantity, for example, 一杯水 (jat1 bui1 seoi2) means 'a cup of water'.
'水' is also used in many compound words related to liquids or water sources, such as 飲用水 (drinking water) or 河水 (river water).
